title: Children Peeling Eggs, Checkered Table - Vintage 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid square-format black-and-white snapshot showing a group of young children gathered closely around a table covered in a bold gingham check tablecloth. The children are focused on peeling hard-boiled eggs, likely in preparation for coloring Easter eggs or a domestic meal. Bowls of eggs, shells, and ingredients sit arranged along the center of the table. The girls wear smocked and ruffled dresses with headbands and hair ribbons characteristic of the late 1960s and early 1970s.
